vb_textbox.text: Each pair of gnomes has one gnome which takes you to a forest with a yellow basket and one with a red basket. In my case the tall brown, tall blue, short orange and short green gnomes led to the red basket. At first the red basket forest gave more mushrooms but I think it switched back and forth at various points.When figuring out the gnomes, try to pay attention to the number of mushrooms collected before the multiplier rather than the total score. In the forest, after collecting the mushrooms, it displays the total score but also a picture of the number of mushrooms actually collected.The range of actual mushrooms collected seems to be around 0-9. Even the good option seemed to occasionally give a low number but I think only the worse option ever gave 0.It seems quite fast at first but once you've memorised which gnomes lead to which forest it becomes easier.Good luck!
